brief.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: One Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, landscape 16:9, target 1920x1080 PNG.
Create exactly ONE finished image for バスケまとめ.

Visual direction: approved hand-painted ink-and-brush sports editorial style; charcoal black #151A18 background, electric lime #CCF43B dry brush sweep, ivory bold Japanese typography. Sparse, strong visual hierarchy, gritty expressive brush marks, no photorealism.

Subject: ONE REAL basketball player, Yuki Ide (井手優希) of Yamaguchi, chosen randomly from names in the fixed article; never a fictional player. Appearance was checked in his official B.LEAGUE portrait https://www.bleague.jp/files/user/roster/2487/2026-27/51000154_03.png. Translate his recognizable features into an ink illustration: compact strong Japanese guard, short black hair with closely cut sides and a lifted tousled top brushed back, visible forehead, dark fairly straight eyebrows, narrow almond-shaped eyes, prominent cheekbones with rounded cheeks, gently tapered oval jaw and small rounded chin, clean-shaven, natural straight nose and broad mouth. Keep his face clearly readable and anatomically credible, with ivory and gray ink shading, and a focused but natural expression. Do not paste any photograph.
Action/composition: place the player in the LEFT 43% of the image, energetic low driving dribble, torso leaning forward diagonally, face in three-quarter view and unobscured, one natural hand controlling a single orange basketball beside the hip/thigh, other arm bent naturally. Frame head through knees if possible, no important hand or ball cropping. Plain ivory/charcoal basketball uniform with small lime edge accents; NO logos, NO team names, NO sponsors, NO jersey number, NO shoe branding. Only one player, no background people. A wide rough lime brush arc behind the player conveys movement. This is a conceptual basketball illustration, NOT a reconstruction of any actual game or decisive play.
Layout: keep RIGHT 55% as clean mostly black negative space for huge crisp Japanese headline; avoid overlap of face/hands/ball with type. Maintain 5% outer safe margins. Large type, uncomplicated composition, legible at thumbnail size.
Exact visible text only, spell perfectly:
Top right, small ivory: "バスケまとめ"
Below it, compact date: "2026.11.07"
Main headline, extremely large bold ivory: "試合結果"
Second headline, very large bold lime: "当日のEFF"
Below the headline, clearly legible ivory single line or balanced two-line note: "19:05時点｜一部公式記録未確定"
Bottom footer, ivory, legible: "イラスト（AI生成）"
Next to footer: "イメージ"

Editorial constraints: The fixed article covers multiple game results and daily EFF; some official records are not yet final as of 19:05 JST. Do not imply all results or rankings are final. Do NOT print the illustrated player's name, stats, appearance claims, ranking, or achievements; random selection is not an editorial claim about his performance. Do not copy any player name, score, date, text, or person from the approved style example. No other text. No team or league logo. Avoid photographic textures, excessive decorations, distorted hands, extra fingers, extra limbs, incomplete letters.

--- Single permitted revision ---
Edit the supplied thumbnail, making ONLY a margin/layout correction. Keep 16:9 landscape resolution at least 1600 pixels wide. This is the single permitted revision.
Preserve ALL text EXACTLY and keep existing text positions, typography, colors, brush style, and face identity. The exact text is バスケまとめ / 2026.11.07 / 試合結果 / 当日のEFF / 19:05時点｜一部公式記録未確定 / イラスト（AI生成） / イメージ. Do not change these.
Change ONLY the illustrated player: uniformly reduce his drawn artwork by about 10-12% and position it so there is clearly visible black/lime background margin of at least 45 pixels between the LEFT edge and the outermost finger, and at least 40 pixels above the highest hair. Keep the orange basketball completely visible and the hands naturally drawn with five fingers; no fingertips may touch or cross the image boundary. Keep his face and hands unobscured and leave separation from the text. Preserve the recognizable likeness of real Yuki Ide, his short black lifted hair, clean-shaven face, uniform without logo or number, and his dynamic dribbling pose. Lower legs may continue below the frame naturally, but all hand/ball/head contours must sit fully inside the frame. Do not add anything and do not change wording.
